race.comment: WESTBOUND (2) lands here as the early Perth Cup favourite. He had to be re-introduced to daylight after his latest run, finishing a head away when the $1.65 fave. Drawing out will suit him better this time and he can sweep down the outside to stamp his authority. DECORATION (3) got the job done last start when dropping back to the mile, scoring by 0.3L. Blake Shinn now hops on board and the run two back in the York Cup stands up. Will handle the quick turnaround and he can play a leading role. CLASSIC IMPACT (8) led and won two back over this track and trip in easier company before being caught very late when leading last time out, hitting the line alongside WESTBOUND. Should find the front again today with no weight on her back and can give another bold sight. HOLLER NUFF (4) won the York Cup 20 days ago and DECORATION has franked that form since. An inside draw and CJP riding are both big ticks. STREET BAND (5) maps to get a lovely run once again and can repeat the dose.
